use default

enum Mark is
    GREY,
    YELLOW,
    GREEN
si

marks(answer: string, guess: string) -> List[Mark] is
    let positions = 0..guess.length

    let unmatched =
        positions
            |> filter(i => guess[i] != answer[i])
            |> map(i => answer[i])
            |> collect_list()

    positions
        |> map(i =>
            if guess[i] == answer[i] then Mark.GREEN
            elif unmatched.remove(guess[i]) then Mark.YELLOW
            else Mark.GREY
            fi)
        |> collect_list()

    ("ALLOW", "LOLLY"),
    ("BULLY", "LOLLY"),
    ("ROBIN", "ALERT"),
    ("ROBIN", "SONIC"),

]

    let shown =
        marks(answer, guess)
            |> map(m => m.to_string().to_lower())
